retrieved.title: Permissions incorrect on \\fs01\hr
retrieved.description: [TCK-61796] Ticket raised because several Noida Tech Park users report they can see the folder \\fs01\hr but get 'access denied' when opening files inside it. This is impacting daily work.
retrieved.resolution: Corrected the inherited NTFS permissions on \\fs01\hr for the relevant Noida Tech Park group and re-propagated ACLs so the files opened as expected.
